# full_stack

Complete installation with every supported service — and the `.env` / `compose.yaml`
are themselves **generated by HELIOS**. Primarily an idempotency test: re-importing
a previously exported stack must produce the same `config.yaml`, which must then
export byte-identical files again.

## Highlights

- **Header `# Generated by HELIOS — DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY!`** in the `.env` — a
  round-trip of an already HELIOS-managed installation.
- **All services present**: `dashboard`, `influxdb`, `postgresql`, `redis`,
  `watchtower`, `helios`, `senec-collector`, `shelly-collector`, `mqtt-collector`,
  `forecast-collector`, `power-splitter`.
- **Full sensor matrix** covering SENEC sensors, 10 `custom_power_*` Shellies
  (with per-device `shelly_password` on the TV) and MQTT sensors for the heat
  pump, Renault battery, outdoor temperature, etc.
- **`heatpump_power.exclude_from_house_power: true`** (from
  `INFLUX_EXCLUDE_FROM_HOUSE_POWER`).
- **pvnode forecast** with an API key.
- **Shelly collector** with 11 devices and an inline per-index
  `SHELLY_PASSWORD=,,,,,,secret,,,,` (password for the TV only).
- **System options** `ui_theme`, `lockup_codeword`, `app_host` all set.
